'''2011 German National Championship Mario Boley LS Dagobah: Yoda's Hut''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mario Boley]] at [[2011 German National Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Dagobah: Yoda's Hut|Dagobah-L-dagobahyodashut.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
